  • Armour of Agathys

    A spectral frost covers you and your gear. When a creature hits you with a melee attack, it takes 5 x spell level⁠⁠Cold.

Necromites are a type of undead creature in Baldur's Gate 3. They are in Moonrise Towers and the Mind Flayer Colony in Act Two.

About

Necromites are skeletal servants and creatures of Myrkul. They can be birthed from a skeletal involucre (see info table to the lower right), created by the spell  Incubate Death. After an involucre incubates for one turn, it explodes and deals 3d8⁠⁠Necrotic damage, birthing a necromite.

As skeletons, necromites are vulnerable to ⁠Bludgeoning damage but resistant to ⁠Necrotic and immune to ⁠Poison.
